environment: Linux x86_64; Rust/Cargo 1.99.1; Iced 0.14.0 tiny-skia/thread-pool; native Wayland human observation and temporary fullscreen Xwayland.

requirements.criterion: Existing accessible workspace accepted; missing or inaccessible directory refused before process launch.
Real controlled task execution reaches coherent observed success, failure or timeout states.
Cancellation remains pending until child termination is observed.
Duplicate actions, workspace changes while busy and late events cannot corrupt another attempt.
Execution and verification leave the actual interface responsive.
Independent oracle approves the correct task-produced result and rejects incorrect bytes or identity.
Absent evidence and completion claims never approve a result.
Changed inputs invalidate current acceptance while preserving prior observations.
Exclusive task directories preserve all preexisting workspace content.
Window close supervises owned work through termination before application exit.
Five evidence states, criterion, attempt, verification run, inputs and observation freshness are visible.

limitations: Controlled local fixtures only; no sandbox, remote agents, persistent history or F0 completion.
Refresh is explicit; displayed acceptance is as of its observation time. Engine history is bounded to 32 observations.
Direct-child supervision only; graceful close waits for work; forced application kill and process descendants are outside this guarantee.
Native observation is reused only after production input/binary comparison; X11 is a separate temporary-server result, not main-session repair.
Some user _new screenshots were unavailable when archival was attempted; direct visual review and explicit human replies are retained.

Verification responsiveness/closing combines worker ownership review and Engine/reducer tests with actual fast graphical verification; no slow-verification graphical capture or numerical latency SLO claimed.

2026-11-01 documentary reconciliation: old input digests preserved under explicit snapshot paths; new task/successor inspections do not represent operational reruns. See docs/validation/f0-reconciliation-20261101/dependency-impact.json.
